prerequisites: Recommended to have previously taken Manufacturing Engineering and Dimensional Quality / V12G380V01604
To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses lower than the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve manufacturing problems in an industrial environment
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems
Ability to write and draft documents
Analysis and synthesis of improvement proposals and problem-solving
Oral and written communication through the presentation of works and reports
Application and use of computer tools
Making changes and experimentation in the process
Teamwork is valued in groups of 3 to 5 people

syllabus_topics: Advanced Measurement and Quality Control Techniques
assessment_rules: For the First Opportunity, students can choose between Continuous Assessment or Global Assessment. In Continuous Assessment, the theoretical exam accounts for 10%, the final work report 30%, manufacturing 40%, and presentation 20%. To pass, a minimum of 40% is required in each section and an overall minimum of 5 out of 10; otherwise, if the total sum is above 5 but a minimum in a section is not met, the grade will be 4.9. Global Assessment comprises a Final Work Report (40%), Manufacturing (40%), and Presentation (20%), with the same passing criteria as Continuous Assessment. For the Second Opportunity (resit), all students will be evaluated according to the Global Assessment guidelines of the First Opportunity. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a global grade of 0.0.
